# OSPFv2 source, replay and Windows auditors

The manifest preserves43 original source files without reformatting. Original external captures, source grids, frozen input/expected matrices and closed producer receipts are required. Use new output directories for adapted executions.

`source39/ospfv2_source_codec_v03.py` is the independent wire source model. Earlier versions and their explicit RFC6549/Fletcher bridges remain historical. `verify_OSPFv2_direct_fields41.py` exports `load_plan` and `verify_case`; pass the returned known-path patterns to retain its absent-field guard. Wire leaves and metadata have separate counters.

`ospfv2_whole_bridge41_v02.py` verifies source-constructed new observations and whole retained objects. Version01 fails because it applies a two-public-input reference schema to unaffected HTTP/3 input; version02 requires those complete files to remain byte literal. Source expectations, grids and constructor witnesses remain unchanged. It does not add a generic transaction or integer normalization.

`run_Windows_OSPFv2_42.py` and `close_Windows_OSPFv2_42.py` cover the actual native console. The first two pages passed in the initial execution; the crypto page needed a navigation-only retry. The closure separately verifies all3 source panes/highlights and root image review. These are exact extracted public packets, not new live captures or terminal pixel screenshots.

`run_OSPFv2_direct43.py` and `close_OSPFv2_helper43.py` repeat all598 direct inputs after the public checksum helper's declared-length guard. Outputs remain byte literal. This follow-up does not claim new native, CLI or UI execution. The exact compiled external Go probe is preserved as `.go.txt` to avoid adding a package or reformatting its executed bytes.

No packet capture, keylog, complete per-case plan/fact/expected object, export/ID ledger, PDML, console cell/image, binary, log or full proof JSON is included. Original absolute paths identify provenance rather than promising that these old controllers run unchanged after relocation. See the [scope and evidence report](../../../../../../../../docs/exec-plans/shark-public-corpus-20261025/ospfv2-cd7af.md).
